purpose: Test the lifecycle recovery path after an optional-client timeout: quarantine and drain during the first RAN phase, stop the client only after releases cease, wait for cleanup, then requalify a fresh conventional service.

selection_source.confirm30: Immediate process/MPS-client retirement during live RAN produced 6/5000 cap100 and 11/5000 cap20 D35 misses.
selection_source.policy_change: Move worker stop and context cleanup outside the live-RAN interval.

fault_phase.policy: drain and reject; no further admissions; stop worker after the final RAN release

requalification_phase.policy: fresh conventional-only process with no AI worker or RPC socket

interpretation_limit: Passing qualifies the tested 20-second maintenance/restart sequence for this A100 setup. It does not bound arbitrary MPS cleanup time, repair deadline misses inside the fault phase, or prove universal hard real-time behavior.
